text:
mira: quick heads up — automated log-scan flagged Authorization headers in partner S3 artifacts: s3://partner-ingest/logs/. Tokens look like `Token tk_partner_***`. Affected tenants: tenant-7, tenant-88, tenant-209. Created ~2026-02-10. No obvious PII in payloads but these are long-lived service tokens. We need immediate rotation + containment. :rotating_light:

owen: are these Vault-managed service tokens or something the partner minted? any indication of export to the partner side?

mira: They map to Vault token roles `partner_integ-*` per our metadata. Partner stores the webhooks and evidently logs full headers into their archival S3 (they're a third-party). I grep'd a sample object locally.

sam: propose immediate 4-step mitigation (short window):
1) disable `partner_integ-*` roles in Vault (prevent new long-lived token issuance)
2) issue short-lived replacement tokens (TTL=15m) for canary tenant and partner handshake
3) create new AWS KMS key/alias and rewrap any envelope keys used to encrypt partner blobs
4) search for other S3 buckets/archives and request partner deletion of archived copies

yara: I'll run discovery queries across our logs and Athena to map scope. Commands I'll use: 
```
aws s3api list-objects --bucket partner-ingest --prefix logs/ --query 'Contents[].Key'
# Athena example
aws athena start-query-execution --query-string "SELECT headers FROM partner_logs WHERE headers LIKE '%Authorization: Token%tenant-7%'" --result-configuration OutputLocation=s3://athena-results/
```
I'll post a CSV of principals and IPs in ~20m.

owen: canary suggestion: start with tenant-209 (lowest traffic). mira DM partner engineering with a signed nonce handshake so they can validate new creds before we rotate tenants 7 and 88.

mira: on it. Also prepping a short revoke script for Vault. Example flow:
```
# disable role
vault write auth/token/roles/partner_integ_webhook disabled=true
# revoke known token ids
vault token revoke -id <token-id> || true
```
I'll coordinate partner notification and request deletion of archived logs on their side.

sam: KMS rewrap plan (AWS):
- create new key: `aws kms create-key --description "partner-encrypt-rot-2026-02"`
- create alias: `aws kms create-alias --alias-name alias/partner-wrap-2026-02 --target-key-id <id>`
- run rewrap job to decrypt envelopes with old alias and re-encrypt with new alias (upload to secure bucket)
I'll also update CloudTrail to watch for any PutObject on partner buckets.

yara: quick discovery update: found 5 distinct principals used the leaked tokens, and 3 geo locations that look unusual. Uploading CSV to secure drive (link posted privately).

owen: tenant-209 canary completed. Partner accepted the nonce-based handshake and posted a test webhook to /_health. No failures reported.

sam: rewrap finished for tenant-209, started tenant-7 rewrap job (ETA ~30-60m). Will flip alias when rewrap verified.

mira: policy follow-ups: after rotation we must enforce TTL caps on partner roles and add a lint/CI check to prevent printing Authorization headers in onboarding scripts. Draft policy snippet for Vault: 
```
# pseudo-policy
path "auth/token/roles/partner_integ_*" {
  capabilities = ["read","update"]
  # enforce maximum ttl on creation via plugin/sentinel: max_ttl = "1h"
}
```
Also add an alert to detect "Authorization: Token" patterns in any outgoing logs (subscribe to guardrails).

ops-bot: Runbook reference: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/secret-exposure-s3 | Incident INC-2026-778 created (priority P2)

yara: posted principals CSV and initial Athena query results in secure thread. Two IPs flagged for further review.

owen: tenant-7 rewrap done and alias rotated. Partner confirmed they updated their decrypt alias; only tenant-88 remains.

sam: starting tenant-88 rotation now. Running a bulk scrub across other buckets for pattern matches (Authorization token, Bearer token, Token tk_partner_).

mira: communication note: include proof-of-rotation (audit IDs, KMS key IDs, rewrap job run IDs) when we ask partner to purge logs. Also add a contractual onboarding clause: do not persist full headers and rotate envelope keys on deploy. Filing JIRA SEC-4571 for follow-up.

ops-bot: Audit action: flagged partner buckets older than 90 days for review.

mira: final status: tenant-209 and tenant-7 rotated and validated; tenant-88 in progress. After tenant-88 completes, we'll re-enable partner role with TTL 1h limit and close incident. Thanks all. :lock:
